idea: Preprints with shorter titles collect more citations at two years because search engines retrieve them more often.
produced_by: the host model alone, without search, with the same idea statement

hypotheses.statement: Shorter titles are retrieved more often.
Prestigious journals impose short titles and attract citations.

tests.title: Regress citations on title length with journal fixed effects
tests.unexpected_under_both: Long titles cited more within journals.

decisive_intervention.description: Page count as a negative control.

recommendation.reason: A within-journal regression separates prestige from title length cheaply.
